facts.fact: On 11 December 2025 the Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications presented to the World Bank a proposal for the Plan Nacional de Telecomunicaciones para la Transformacion Digital, which includes a competitive network ensuring 100% coverage before 2030; the article describes it as a plan still to be designed with World Bank technical assistance.
